detail.title: Provisional Review: Architectural Consensus and Self-Monitoring
detail.summary: This review synthesizes the current state of cognitive architecture literature, noting a reliance on standardized survey paradigms and foundational agent architectures, which provides a basis for examining limits in autonomous error-detection.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook to reflect the constrained availability of technical self-monitoring data within the surveyed architectural literature.
